description.text: B.A. Credit Management Objectives: The Credit Management specialty aims to train students with a high quality of professional knowledge to meet the need of the construction of the Socialist Market Economy and the need of many other fields concerned with securities, insurance, credit management, etc. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main courses: Political Economy, Macro-Economics, Micro-Economics, Accounting, Monetary and Banking, , Insurance, Financial， Stock Investment, Business and Operation of Commercial Bank, Trust Management, Credit Risk Management, Trust Management of Enterprise and Individual, Credit Rating, Assets Evaluation, etc.

duration.text: The Credit Management at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
